summary: Completed live backend and responsive browser smoke testing for the TonAer homepage.

integration_issues.issue: submit catches every POST error and sets sent=true, showing a false success state when /api/contact is unavailable or rejects the request.

action_items: Add a visible contact submission error state and only set sent=true after a successful POST.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js submit() treats network/API errors as successful submissions, misleading users and masking backend outages.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST-prefixed contact leads via live regression requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage sections, hero anchor, desktop contact modal validation/submission, mobile menu open/close, and mobile overflow passed. Recheck contact POST failure behavior after fix.
rca of the issue: The catch block in App.js line 21 calls setSent(true) rather than storing an error. Any non-2xx response or network failure renders MESSAGE RECEIVED without confirmation from the API.
